title: Sustained Yap/Taz activation promotes aberrant alveolar epithelial cell differentiation and drives persistent fibrotic remodeling
overall_design: Cultured CD326+ epithelial cells from wild-type and Yap/Taz active (driven by Stk3/4 deletion in Sftpc+ AT2 cells) with Tomato lineage trace. After Passage 1, cells were flow sorted for Tomato+ to isalate only lineage traced cells. Cells were then cultured an additional 10 days in SFFFM media then either continued in SFFFM or switched to alveolar differentiation media (ADM) for 7 days. Cells were then bulk RNA sequenced.
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing

title: Wild type, ADM, sample 1
treatment_protocol_ch1: There were no treatments beyond changing the media
growth_protocol_ch1: Cells were isolated from WT or Yap/Taz active mice that were injected with 3mg/mouse tamoxifen 2-weeks prior. CD326+ epithelial cells were isolated with Miltenyi beads. Cells were cultuired for 2-weeks in serum-free-feeder free media (SFFFM) as per the Katsura et al (PMID:33128895) protocol. TdTomato+ lineage labeled cells were then flow sorted and cultured again in SFFFM for 10 days and then either continued in SFFFM or switched to alveolar differentiation media for 7-days. Organoids were then imaged and cells extracted via dispase.
extract_protocol_ch1: Once cells were isolated RNA was extracted following Qiagen Rneasy mini-plus kit protocol using RLT.

ERCC RNA Spike-In Mix (Cat: #4456740) from ThermoFisher Scientific, was added to normalized total RNA prior to library preparation following manufacturer’s protocol. The NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina & NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (New England Biolabs, Ipswich, MA, USA) were used.
data_processing: Trimmomatic v.0.36. was used to remove adaptor sequences
Trimmed reads were mapped and BAM files were generated using STAR aligner v.2.5.2b
Unique gene hit counts were calculated by using feature Counts from the Subread package v.1.5.2. Only unique reads that fell within exon regions were counted
DESeq2 was used for comparison between groups. Genes with adjusted P values < 0.05 and absolute log2 fold changes >0.5 were called as differentially expressed genes for each comparison.
Assembly: GRCm38
Supplementary files format and content: csv count files
